notes: Windows x64 only: one NSIS leg in release-targets.json.
The Rust workspace is the repository root and the Tauri crate is app/src-tauri, so caches and bundles use the root target/.
ci.yml adds a native Windows job: the Windows-only code compiles to nothing on Linux.
release-please uses versioning always-bump-patch: every release before 0.1.0 bumps the patch number only.
No .oxfmtignore: oxfmt reads ignorePatterns from .oxfmtrc.json and only .gitignore/.prettierignore by default.
